answer: High-water is the default and recommended allocation method for array user shares; it switches drives at half the largest drive's capacity.
The Tunable (md_write_method) setting on Settings → Disk Settings selects the array write mode, including Turbo Write (Reconstruct).
Unraid limits the ZFS ARC read cache to usually about one eighth (1/8th) of total RAM.
FROM is the mandatory Modelfile instruction; it names the base model.
